title: WordPress migrate to self-hosted EmDash — product walkthrough

beats.narration: Agencies inherit WordPress sites that are hard to modernise. Here is a self-hosted EmDash distribution that imports the content and keeps agents from taking the site offline.
This is a throwaway demo site after migration — public pages, not a client pilot.
In admin, collections replace the old WordPress post types. Content is ready for editors and reviewed agent publishes.
The go-live check blocks only on what visitors can reach. Template leftovers go to a review list instead of failing the launch.
